Name: Clothing and Hat Catalogues
Author: Saah
Description:
[size=5]Description[/size]
[quote]Could any modder make some kind of clothing catalogue? Where you could choose any clothing that you want including hats, I recomend it to be sold by the hat mouse, you can put the price, I'd really apreciate it. Tks :) .[/quote]
This mod was [url=https://github.com/StardewModders/mod-ideas/issues/1234]requested[/url] in the [url=https://github.com/StardewModders/mod-ideas/]mod-ideas repo[/url]. It adds two new catalogues to the game:
[list]
[*]Hat Catalogue: Contains all hats in the game. Sold by the Hat Mouse for 50,000g.
[*]Clothing Catalogue: Contains all pants and shirts in the game. Sold by Sandy for 20,000g.
[/list]
Unfortunately, they aren't sorted and don't have any tabs. Also, most shirts in the game are simply called "Shirt", that's not a bug.

[size=5]Requirements[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22364]Catalogue Framework[/url]﻿
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]No known incompatibilities
[*] Not tested in Android or versions lower than 1.6.4
[*] Compatible with any mods that add clothing [b]objects[/b] to the game (Fashion Sense doesn't, Json Assets and Content Patcher do)
[*] Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22379]Catalogue Filter - Continued[/url]
[/list]
[size=5]Feedback[/size]
This isn't a mod I ever see myself using, so I'm not interested in improving it. I'm not accepting any suggestions for it unless you've either found a bug or thought of a better price tag for the catalogues.

[size=5]Contributing[/size]
[list]
[*][b]Translations:[/b] Send me your i18n json file and I'll add it to this mod.
[*][b]Art:[/b] I just did whatever for the sprites, if you want to draw better ones I'd appreciate it. You'll be properly credited.
[*][b]Coding:[/b] If you want to improve upon this mod, go ahead as long as you don't make money from it. If you send me the Nexus page of your improved version, I'll link it here.
[*][b]Bug Reporting:[/b] Please do that in the Bugs tab, not in Posts. People never read the posts to see if someone has already reported their issue.

[/list]
